```yaml
name: Backend Required Quality Gate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master, develop]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  # Job 1: Classify paths to determine which gates are required
  classify-paths:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      backend-changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.backend }}
      security-changed: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.security }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Filter paths
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          filters: |
            backend:
              - 'tldw_Server_API/**'
              - 'requirements*.txt'
              - 'pyproject.toml'
              - 'setup.py'
              - '.github/workflows/backend*.yml'
            security:
              - 'tldw_Server_API/**'
              - 'requirements*.txt'
              - 'pyproject.toml'
              - 'setup.py'
              - '.github/workflows/security*.yml'
              - 'Dockerfile'
              - 'docker-compose*.yml'

  # Job 2: Backend Quality Gate
  # Runs if backend files changed, otherwise passes no-op
  backend-gate:
    needs: classify-paths
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ needs.classify-paths.outputs.backend-changed == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push' }}
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f requirements-dev.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements-dev.txt; fi
          pip install pytest pytest-cov bandit

      - name: Run Backend Tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci tldw_Server_API/tests/CI || true

      - name: Run Bandit Security Lint
        run: |
          python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json || true

      - name: No-op pass if no backend changes
        if: ${{ needs.classify-paths.outputs.backend-changed == 'false' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
        run: echo "No backend changes detected. Skipping backend gate."

  # Job 3: Security Quality Gate
  # Runs if security-relevant files changed, otherwise passes no-op
  security-gate:
    needs: classify-paths
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: ${{ needs.classify-paths.outputs.security-changed == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push' }}
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Dependency Review
        uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v4
        with:
          fail-on-severity: critical
          comment-summary-in-pr: always

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          pip install bandit

      - name: Run Bandit Security Scan
        run: |
          python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_security_scan.json || true

      - name: No-op pass if no security changes
        if: ${{ needs.classify-paths.outputs.security-changed == 'false' && github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
        run: echo "No security-relevant changes detected. Skipping security gate."

  # Job 4: Final Gate Aggregation
  # Ensures all required gates pass
  quality-gate:
    needs: [backend-gate, security-gate]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    
    steps:
      - name: Check gate results
        run: |
          echo "Backend Gate Status: ${{ needs.backend-gate.result }}"
          echo "Security Gate Status: ${{ needs.security-gate.result }}"
          
          if [[ "${{ needs.backend-gate.result }}" != "success" && "${{ needs.backend-gate.result }}" != "skipped" ]]; then
            echo "Backend gate failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [[ "${{ needs.security-gate.result }}" != "success" && "${{ needs.security-gate.result }}" != "skipped" ]]; then
            echo "Security gate failed."
            exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "All required quality gates passed."
```
